brandVoice.tone: Friendly, direct, and benefit-led. Emphasises freedom (unlimited, no lock-in, full ownership) and simplicity (fast, a few minutes, no friction). Avoids jargon — speaks to a non-technical audience building forms for their team or business.

steps.text: Visitor lands on the marketing homepage or pricing page.
Visitor clicks 'Create a free form' or 'Get started free' CTA.
Visitor arrives at the registration page.
Visitor enters name, email, selects 'How did you hear about us?', and creates a password.
Visitor accepts terms & conditions and submits the registration form.
User lands on the authenticated dashboard.

risks.signal: Field abandonment — user focuses first input then idles > 20s without completing remaining fields
risks.label: Registration form friction: 5 fields + captcha before account creation

risks.signal: Error banner visible after form submit — password validation fails
risks.label: Password strength requirements cause repeated failed submissions

risks.signal: Dwell > 15s on dashboard with no clicks — empty state visible
risks.label: New user lands on empty dashboard and doesn't know what to do next

interventions.content: You're almost there — just a name, email, and password. Takes under a minute.
interventions.goal: Reduce perceived effort to complete the registration form

interventions.content: Your password needs at least 8 characters with a mix of letters and numbers. Try a phrase you'll remember.
interventions.goal: Resolve password validation failure on first retry

interventions.content: Welcome! Click 'Create Form' to build your first form — you can start with AI, a template, or from scratch.
interventions.goal: Bridge the empty-state gap and direct user to their first action

steps.text: User clicks 'Create Form' from the dashboard.
Form style modal: choose Classic (multi-page) or Focused (one question at a time).
Creation method modal: AI generation, import from URL/file, template, or blank contact form.
User builds the form in the editor — adds fields, configures logic, customises styling.
User clicks 'Publish' to save and make the form live.
User is redirected to the Share page for the newly created form.

risks.signal: Dwell > 20s on style selection modal with no click
risks.label: User unsure whether to pick Classic or Focused form style

risks.signal: Editor page loaded but no field added within 30s
risks.label: User opens editor but doesn't know how to start adding fields

risks.signal: Error banner visible after save attempt — 422 validation error
risks.label: Form save fails due to validation error the user can't resolve

interventions.content: Classic is great for longer forms with sections. Focused works best for surveys and lead capture — one question at a time keeps completion rates high.
interventions.goal: Help user pick a form style confidently

interventions.content: Click the + button on the left to add your first field. Try a short text or email field to start.
There's an issue with one of your fields — check the highlighted sections above and fix the validation errors, then try saving again.
interventions.goal: Help user resolve validation error on their own

steps.text: Unauthenticated visitor arrives at the guest form builder.
Creation modal appears to choose form style and creation method (AI/import/blank).
Visitor builds the form using the editor without an account.
Visitor attempts to save/publish — guest save triggers registration prompt.
Quick-register modal appears inline without leaving the editor.
Visitor completes registration within the modal.
Form is saved and user is redirected to the share page.

risks.signal: Editor dwell > 60s with no field added
risks.label: Guest user engaged but confused in editor without prior orientation

risks.signal: Quick-register modal opened then closed without submission within 10s
risks.label: User abandons when registration modal unexpectedly appears at save time

risks.signal: Share page loaded but no copy-link or embed action within 20s
risks.label: User created form but doesn't realise they need to share/embed it

interventions.content: Try describing your form in the AI prompt — you'll get a working draft in seconds that you can tweak.
interventions.goal: Reduce blank-canvas paralysis for guest users

interventions.content: Create a free account to save your work — your form is safe and won't be lost.
interventions.goal: Reassure user their form won't vanish and lower registration resistance

interventions.content: Your form is live! Copy the link below to share it, or grab the embed code to put it on your website.
interventions.goal: Guide user to the natural next step after publishing

steps.text: User navigates to the submissions tab from the form sidebar.
User views the submissions table with response data.
User filters, exports, or views individual submission details.

risks.signal: Submissions page loaded with 0 rows — empty state visible
risks.label: No submissions yet — user may think form isn't working

risks.signal: User hovers export button multiple times without clicking
risks.label: User unsure how export works or which format to choose

interventions.content: No responses yet — share your form link to start collecting submissions. You can also submit a test response yourself.
interventions.goal: Reassure user the form works and direct them to share it

interventions.content: Export is straightforward — tooltip already explains the options. Intervening here would be patronising.
interventions.goal: Respect user autonomy on a well-labelled UI action

steps.text: User visits the pricing page or sees the upgrade banner on the dashboard.
User compares Free, Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans; toggles monthly/yearly billing.
User clicks the 'Get started free' CTA on their chosen paid plan.
User is redirected to Stripe checkout to enter payment details.
User returns to the subscription success page while status is verified.

risks.signal: Pricing page dwell > 45s with interaction on plan toggles but no CTA click
risks.label: Decision fatigue — user comparing plans but can't commit

risks.signal: Redirect to Stripe triggered but no return to success page within 5 minutes
risks.label: User abandons at Stripe checkout

risks.signal: Success page polling for > 20s without subscription confirmed
risks.label: Webhook delay makes user think payment failed

interventions.content: Most teams start with Pro — it removes branding and unlocks custom domains. You can upgrade to Business later if you need advanced integrations.
interventions.goal: Collapse the decision to a recommended plan

interventions.content: You were checking out the {{plan}} plan — your form builder is waiting. Complete checkout to unlock all features: {{checkout_link}}
interventions.goal: Recover abandoned checkout via async nudge

interventions.content: The page already shows a spinner and 'checking status' message. Additional intervention would be redundant — let the polling resolve.
interventions.goal: Avoid interrupting an expected technical delay

coverageGaps: Backend API (api/ directory) was not deeply analysed — only referenced where composables call endpoints
i18n file only covers form-respondent strings (submit, file upload); dashboard/admin copy is inline in Vue templates
Admin panel (client/pages/admin.vue) was not explored — assumed internal/operator-only
Self-hosted license flow (client/pages/self-hosted/) was not analysed in detail
Comparison pages (opnform-vs-*.vue) are SEO/marketing and were not individually read
No tailwind.config file exists — using Nuxt UI v4 with @theme block in CSS; some token resolution may be imprecise
Dark mode tokens inferred from CSS :where(.dark) selectors — the app defaults to light mode (colorMode.preference: 'light')
notes: OpnForm uses Nuxt UI (v3/@nuxt/ui) for the component library and Tailwind CSS v4 via @theme directives instead of a traditional tailwind.config. The primary color is blue, configured in app.config.ts. The app supports feature flags (useFeatureFlag) for billing, AI features, self-hosted mode, and Google auth. Analytics are tracked through Amplitude, Google Tag Manager, and Crisp. Forms can be embedded via iframe with postMessage communication for submission events. The guest form creation flow is a key conversion mechanism — users build value before being asked to sign up.
